title: Evaluation of a depth circuit
statement: Let $C$ be a depth circuit and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. The value of $C$ at $x$ is obtained by evaluating its tail on the first-layer values, using the dual of the first-layer gate as the tail's output gate.
